serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Hobo: Listen dude, I apologize for that, but I didn't have a choice… {{wi}}It’s cold, food is expensive and these psycho kids are bothering me at night. Next time these little fuckers could actually curb stomp me!
You: Yeah, some of these are actual problems, but food? Come on man, bread is free these days.
Hobo: You mean bread from the dispenser? That shit is inedible dude.
You: It’s not that bad. Maybe it’s because of your attitude that you ended up like that, huh?
Hobo: Bro, are you really gonna preach to me at {gv_Hour}? Besides, last time I ate this bread I got giant diarrhea for like a week! Even a clean water dispenser didn’t help me with dehydration from that!
You: Never heard of someone having such a reaction to it. Is it tasteless? Yes, but my stomach feels ok after eating it.
Hobo: Lucky you, hun. Regardless, this shit fucks up everybody in some way, so better stop eating it.
You: Alright, alright. Thanks for the advice I guess.
You: Anyway, what are you planning on doing, huh? Are you just gonna wander around and steal from people?
Hobo: Don’t you think it’s pretty unreasonable to ask someone in my situation for their long-term plans?
You: Y-you might be right…
Hobo: Whatever. Obviously, my plan is to just get a house at some point. Rent something, find a job, et cetera. 
Hobo: Of course! You can help me with this, I’m open to receiving donations~
Geez, this guy is shameless…
I’m not gonna give him a buck, he attacked me after all. Our today’s small talk changes nothing.
